units.source_text: 北斗星熠熠生辉，洒满整个山峰，绝壁上的松树依旧被风吹得微微颤动。

en.t: The Big Dipper shone brightly, scattering its light over the whole mountain peak, while the pine trees on the sheer cliff still trembled faintly in the wind.

units.source_text: 但是，杜子春却已经面朝天空躺在岩石上，死了。

en.t: But Toshishun was already lying on the rock with his face turned toward the sky, dead.
